freeze_semantics: Formalized after the recorded repo-local, pinned-mathlib, and public discovery. It freezes the append-only final inventory and governs validation rechecks, not the timing of the discovery observations.
search_order: repo-local Lean proof bodies and wrappers outside this target and dependency cache
pinned mathlib declarations, terminal body, imports, and immutable local history
other public Lean 4 repositories at immutable revisions
historical Lean versions and other proof assistants as research-only evidence
human primary sources needed for unresolved source boundaries
declaration_and_api_queries: rg over repo-local *.lean for the aliases and matching/odd-component conjunctions
rg and git object/history inspection over pinned mathlib for the aliases, theorem declarations, and proof body
Sourcegraph public streaming search with archived and forked repositories included, language Lean, bounded result count
GitHub REST repository search for Tutte plus Lean/Lean4 aliases
GitHub REST code search for theorem/declaration aliases, retaining authentication or rate failures
grep.app public code search for theorem/declaration aliases, retaining access failures
immutable commit/tree/raw-file inspection for any discovered external candidate
historical and other-prover queries as research-only evidence

immutable_selection_rules.repo_local: Bind results to the repository base revision and tree; never transfer proof credit from another target.
immutable_selection_rules.mathlib: Use only the lake-manifest pin and clean materialized tree. Inspect history only through already-present Git objects and require the origin object to be an ancestor of the pin.
immutable_selection_rules.external: Resolve moving refs to a full commit and tree before candidate classification, and bind inspected source to that commit and a content hash.
immutable_selection_rules.negative_search: Bind dated queries to a response hash or explicit access failure. A bounded zero result never proves global absence.

credential_policy: Use unauthenticated public read APIs only. Do not expose credentials, clone or fetch dependencies, change Lake inputs, or mutate Formalizations/Lean/.lake. Record HTTP 401, 403, 429, and search limits rather than bypassing them.
network_policy: Network is permitted only for read-only discovery metadata and immutable raw-source inspection. Candidate elaboration uses the existing local pinned toolchain without network access.
expected_negative_evidence: HTTP or search status and bounded result count
response-body SHA-256 or exact local rg exit
access, indexing, archival, shard-limit, and credential limitations
no saturation claim without independent review
candidate_fields_required: module, file, blob, source hash, declaration, and exact type
toolchain, dependency pins, license, and local integration feasibility
normalized comparison with every canonical binder and boundary
wrapper versus terminal declaration and proof-body provenance
machine-produced axioms and foundation fit where locally checkable
parser-aware placeholder, bodyless, unsafe, oracle, external-code, and generated-artifact boundary
smallest direct check, truthful M classification, blocker, and reopen condition
status_boundary: This is an honest reconstructed protocol for an audit whose recorded discovery preceded formalization. It freezes the final inventory append-only and governs validation rechecks. It does not support a precommitted-discovery or exhaustive-saturation claim, accepted proof state, or theorem completion.
